title: Item 7 — Token Telemetry, Docs Automation and Scope Validation Hardening
description: Implement frozen Multi-Agent V1 Item 7 without renumbering: deterministic provider-neutral Token Telemetry using the Spec v3.1 canonical telemetry path, reproducible Docs Automation with an isolated generated-output namespace, and mandatory Scope Validation Hardening. The scope hardening provides a pre-change validator for authorized agent writes plus a required-CI commit-history backstop that rejects transient out-of-scope or forbidden commits even when later reverted. package.json and required workflows remain untouched because the existing multi-agent test wildcard automatically executes new test files.

token_budget_policy.item7_rationale: Manager-selected implementation budget for this MEDIUM task; Token Telemetry observes and evaluates it but does not derive it.
token_budget_policy.future_calibration: Item 9 may recommend/calibrate future per-risk-class budgets from canonical telemetry. It may not silently rewrite an in-flight Task Contract.

external_gate_evidence.rule: MEDIUM requires exact-artifact independent Review PASS and ACTIVE lock evidence. Security and Project Owner Human Gate are not required unless effective risk escalates to HIGH.

telemetry_contract.persistence_rule: The service resolves the canonical path from task_id and persists telemetry only from explicit reported usage. Item 7 does not fabricate a self-telemetry record merely to populate the directory.
telemetry_contract.calibration_rule: Only MERGED tasks that were not human-rejected are primary calibration samples. ABORTED and HUMAN_REJECTED telemetry is retained but excluded from the primary sample.

docs_automation_contract.drift_rule: Check mode compares deterministic expected bytes with the owned generated output and fails on stale output; it never rewrites incident history or task state.
docs_automation_contract.wiring_note: Item 7 does not add or alter required workflows. Exact-PR and post-merge pnpm verify execute the generated-catalog drift test through the existing multi-agent wildcard. The executable also supports explicit manual/check invocation; adding a dedicated scheduler would require a separately scoped workflow task.

live_pr_test_policy.local_behavior: SKIP only when not running in a GitHub pull_request environment because no authoritative PR base/head event context exists locally.
live_pr_test_policy.canonical_ci_behavior: On GitHub pull_request Canonical CI the test must resolve the exact PR base/head, inspect every branch-only commit and PASS. SKIP, NOT_EXECUTED, or missing authoritative event context on the required PR check blocks Item 7 closure.
live_pr_test_policy.security_interpretation: Local SKIP is environment-gated behavior, not a security exception.

local_test_result.skip_reason: Only the live pull_request context test is skipped outside GitHub pull_request CI.

implementation_status.claim: Local implementation evidence only. Canonical CI, Phase A, merge-policy, artifact-bound Review/Lock and post-merge verification remain mandatory and unverified until the Item 7 PR executes them.

acceptance_criteria.description: Token Telemetry implements Spec v3.1 §18, including canonical storage .eqcofe/telemetry/<task_id>.json, the context_tokens_read subset invariant, explicit-source-only usage, and no fabricated billing/provider data.

Token budgets are explicit Task Contract inputs, not automatically derived from risk. The service requires integer 0 < expected_max < soft_alert < hard_cap and reports NORMAL, EXPECTED_EXCEEDED, SOFT_ALERT or HARD_CAP_EXCEEDED deterministically.

Docs Automation reads canonical Task Contracts and owns only docs/14-multi-agent/generated/TASK-CATALOG.md. It must not overwrite incidents, GOVERNANCE.md, or other manually maintained documents; check mode fails on stale generated bytes.

Scope Validation reuses canonical validateChangedPaths semantics, validates explicit pre-change paths and git ranges, is rename-aware, and rejects OUT_OF_SCOPE and FORBIDDEN_SCOPE paths with forbidden scope taking precedence.

The required verify check executes the live PR scope-history test. A deterministic regression creates an out-of-scope commit and then reverts it; range/history validation must still FAIL. A clean in-scope history must PASS.

Local execution may SKIP only the live PR-context case. On the exact Item 7 pull_request required Canonical CI, the live scope-history test must execute and PASS; SKIP/NOT_EXECUTED/missing PR context is blocking.

Process Hardening documents the two-layer model: authorized agents must run deterministic pre-change validation before repository writes, and required CI independently validates complete branch-only commit history. Documentation explicitly states the residual boundary that an out-of-band direct API/operator push to an unprotected feature branch cannot be prevented by repository code alone, but is detected and blocked from canonical merge.

No package.json, lockfile, required workflow, Ruleset, protected-main permission, frozen GOVERNANCE.md, Merge Policy Controller, product runtime, database, API contract, or Step 57 artifact is changed by Item 7.

Full canonical pnpm verify, Phase A Verification and required Merge Policy check pass on the exact Item 7 artifact; Item 8 remains forbidden until the separate Pre-Pilot Verification Gate passes after Item 7 canonical closure.

process_hardening.trigger: five operational incidents with three scope slips
controls: pre-change explicit path validation for authorized agent writes
git-range and complete branch-only commit-history validation
documented residual boundary for out-of-band feature-branch pushes
process_hardening.claim_limit: Item 7 may claim that committed scope slips cannot pass canonical required CI/merge eligibility. It must not claim that GitHub can cryptographically prevent every out-of-band write to an unprotected feature branch.
